item.title: Targeting high-value uses to unlock the mitigation potential of clean hydrogen
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02766-y

Clean hydrogen is a versatile decarbonization option, but given its energy-intensive production, high costs and limited near-term supply, uses with the greatest environmental and economic benefits must be prioritized. Analysis of ten end-use sectors identifies high-value applications and suggests that uniform supply-side subsidies risk misallocating clean hydrogen and public funds, highlighting the need for sector-specific demand-side policies.
item.dc:title: Targeting high-value uses to unlock the mitigation potential of clean hydrogen

item.title: Increased southward swings of the South Indian convergence zone under greenhouse warming
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02767-x

Extreme southward swings of the South Indian convergence zone can lead to severe rainfall and flooding in southern Africa. Here the authors show that climate change leads to an increase in the frequency and intensity of such swings.
item.dc:title: Increased southward swings of the South Indian convergence zone under greenhouse warming
